checklist_items_moment_check.name: checklist_items_moment_check
checklist_items_moment_check.value: jsonb_typeof(moment) = 'object' AND CASE moment ->> 'type' WHEN 'deadline' THEN (moment - ARRAY['type', 'date']::text[]) = '{}'::jsonb AND (moment -> 'date') IS NOT NULL WHEN 'beforeDeparture' THEN (moment - ARRAY['type']::text[]) = '{}'::jsonb WHEN 'tripDay' THEN (moment - ARRAY['type', 'day']::text[]) = '{}'::jsonb AND (moment -> 'day') IS NOT NULL ELSE false END

generation_runs_batch_check.name: generation_runs_batch_check
generation_runs_batch_check.value: ("generation_runs"."kind" = 'batch') = ("generation_runs"."base_version" IS NOT NULL) AND ("generation_runs"."kind" = 'batch') = ("generation_runs"."deck_closure_id" IS NOT NULL)

preference_prompts_category_check.name: preference_prompts_category_check
preference_prompts_category_check.value: ("preference_prompts"."kind" = 'category') = ("preference_prompts"."category" IS NOT NULL) AND ("preference_prompts"."category" IS NULL OR "preference_prompts"."category" IN ('museum', 'walk', 'nature', 'tasting', 'restaurant', 'heritage', 'market', 'nightlife'))

preference_signals_cancellation_check.name: preference_signals_cancellation_check
preference_signals_cancellation_check.value: ("preference_signals"."status" = 'cancelled') = ("preference_signals"."previous_status" IS NOT NULL) AND ("preference_signals"."status" = 'cancelled') = ("preference_signals"."cancelled_at" IS NOT NULL) AND ("preference_signals"."status" = 'cancelled') = ("preference_signals"."cancel_request_id" IS NOT NULL)

preference_signals_form_check.name: preference_signals_form_check
preference_signals_form_check.value:
CASE
        WHEN "preference_signals"."signal" IN ('like', 'dislike', 'choose', 'nextOption') THEN "preference_signals"."origin" = 'gesture' AND "preference_signals"."category" IS NOT NULL AND "preference_signals"."proposal_id" IS NOT NULL AND "preference_signals"."reason" IS NULL
        WHEN "preference_signals"."signal" = 'answerYes' THEN "preference_signals"."origin" = 'question' AND "preference_signals"."category" IS NOT NULL AND "preference_signals"."proposal_id" IS NULL
        WHEN "preference_signals"."signal" = 'answerNo' THEN "preference_signals"."origin" = 'question' AND "preference_signals"."proposal_id" IS NULL
        WHEN "preference_signals"."signal" = 'travelReduction' THEN "preference_signals"."origin" = 'question' AND "preference_signals"."category" IS NULL AND "preference_signals"."proposal_id" IS NULL AND "preference_signals"."reason" IS NULL
        ELSE false
      END

preference_signals_card_place_check.name: preference_signals_card_place_check
preference_signals_card_place_check.value: "preference_signals"."signal" IN ('like', 'dislike', 'choose', 'nextOption') OR ("preference_signals"."place_id" IS NULL AND "preference_signals"."candidate_id" IS NULL)

stays_area_center_check.name: stays_area_center_check
stays_area_center_check.value: ("stays"."area_center_lat" IS NULL AND "stays"."area_center_lng" IS NULL AND "stays"."area_radius_m" IS NULL) OR ("stays"."area_center_lat" BETWEEN -90 AND 90 AND "stays"."area_center_lng" BETWEEN -180 AND 180 AND "stays"."area_radius_m" BETWEEN 50 AND 20000)
